load_rt_compat_runtime: load the polars compat runtime module by calling rt_compat()
load_rt_64_runtime: load the polars 64-bit runtime module by calling rt_64()
load_rt_32_runtime: load the polars 32-bit runtime module by calling rt_32()
force_polars_runtime_pkg: force a specific polars runtime variant via POLARS_FORCE_PKG environment variable
prefer_polars_runtime_pkg: prefer a specific polars runtime variant via POLARS_PREFER_PKG environment variable
